## get sample names
```{r cars}
fastq.dir <- "/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/fastqs/fastp"

all.files <- list.files(fastq.dir)

snames <- gsub(".fastq", "", all.files)
```

qsub -t 0-{x} fastp.pbs
```{r}

fileOut<-file(paste0("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/scripts/pbs/bewell-srascrub.pbs"))
  
fastq <- paste0(fastq.dir, "/${snames[$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX]}.fastq")
 
writeLines(c(paste0("#PBS -N bewell-srascrub"),
               "#PBS -l walltime=1:00:00",
               "#PBS -l nodes=1:ppn=28",
               "#PBS -j oe",
               "#PBS -m ae",
               "#PBS -A PAS1695",
               "",
               
               #List sample naames in a way that can be indexed
               paste0("snames=('", paste(snames, collapse = "' '"), "')"),
               
               "",
               "cd /users/PAS1695/whee57/Github/sra-human-scrubber",
               "",
          
               paste0("./scripts/scrub.sh -i ", fastq, 
                      " -o - -p 8 /fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/fastqs/sra-scrubbed/${snames[$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX]}.fastq 2> /fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/scripts/logs/srasrub-${snames[$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX]}.log")
               
  ),
  
  fileOut
  )
```
